profile: Military-friendly Beale AFB housing snapshot anchored to the Marysville, Wheatland, Plumas Lake, and Yuba-Sutter market, built for PCSUnited base-level market overviews.

market_metrics.market_type_summary: Steady demand in growth corridors with California affordability pressure

mortgage_assumptions.defaults_note: Based on March 2026 California VA loan rates.

notes: California purchase prices make true monthly ownership cost more sensitive to interest rate and target price.
Property tax exposure is lower than Texas-style tax markets but still meaningful at California home values.
Insurance, utilities, wildfire-adjacent risk, commute distance, and maintenance reserves should be included in all-in housing comparisons.

avg_home_mortgage_monthly.notes: VA loan estimate; Plumas Lake and Wheatland are primary growth markets.

crime_status.metro_yuba_sutter: Marysville has higher crime rates in older districts; Wheatland and Plumas Lake are often preferred by military families for safety, newer housing, and family lifestyle fit.

school_quality.on_base: Lone Tree Elementary and local Wheatland-area school options may serve many base-connected families; families should verify current attendance boundaries by exact housing address.
school_quality.off_base: Wheatland and Plumas Lake districts are commonly preferred by military families; Marysville and Yuba City options vary and should be verified by address.

rental_vacancy.notes: Steady supply of single-family rentals in newer developments, especially in growth corridors near Wheatland and Plumas Lake.

rental_metrics.notes: Based on 3-bedroom average rent and steady single-family rental demand in the Beale / Yuba-Sutter market.

military_lifestyle_fit.description: Quiet rural feel with high community support; Beale is a major economic and military anchor for the Yuba-Sutter region.

financial_brief.affordability_summary: Beale offers a lower California entry cost compared with many other California military markets, but buyers still need to respect the all-in monthly cost of California home prices.
financial_brief.buyer_opportunity: Strongest opportunities appear in Plumas Lake, Wheatland, and selected Marysville/Yuba City pockets where commute, home condition, and resale appeal align.

market_bluf.bluf_summary: Beale offers a quieter lifestyle, stable military demand, and comparatively reachable California housing, especially in Plumas Lake and Wheatland growth corridors.

summary_points: Beale AFB gives military families one of the more approachable California housing markets compared with coastal or major-metro installations.
Plumas Lake and Wheatland are key growth corridors for buyers wanting newer housing and stronger family fit.
Marysville can offer affordability, but property condition, crime, and resale should be reviewed carefully.
California home prices still create payment pressure, even when Beale is more affordable than Travis, Vandenberg, or coastal markets.
The best Beale housing decision balances commute, BAH, schools, insurance, utility cost, and long-term resale logic.
opportunities: Lower California entry price than many other Air Force markets.
Wheatland and Plumas Lake provide stronger family and newer-home options.
Stable military presence supports long-term housing relevance.
Rural-suburban lifestyle may appeal to families wanting less congestion.
Buyers may find more space for the money compared with larger California metros.
risks: California purchase prices can still create high monthly payments relative to income.
Marysville and older districts require stronger crime, school, and property-condition screening.
Commute distance from some preferred areas can become a quality-of-life factor.
Wildfire-adjacent risk, insurance, heat, and utility costs should be included in ownership planning.
Lower-growth rural markets may not appreciate as aggressively as larger California metros.
buyer_notes: Beale is a strong market for disciplined VA buyers who want California access without coastal-level pricing.
Focus on all-in monthly cost, not just the home price.
Plumas Lake and Wheatland should usually be compared first for family fit, resale, and newer housing options.
Marysville can work, but buyers should perform property-level and neighborhood-level due diligence.
This market rewards buyers who protect residual income and avoid stretching into California payment pressure.
seller_notes: Sellers should position homes around commute, family fit, condition, energy efficiency, and affordability compared with larger California markets.
Move-in-ready homes in Wheatland or Plumas Lake can appeal strongly to military families.
Homes in older areas should be priced and presented with condition transparency.
Military-friendly listing language should highlight BAH practicality, commute simplicity, and nearby services.
investor_angles: Military demand supports rental relevance near Beale, especially for clean single-family homes in practical commute corridors.
Plumas Lake and Wheatland may provide stronger family-renter appeal than generic low-price areas.
Investors should stress-test California acquisition cost, insurance, maintenance, vacancy, and property management.
Best suited for stability-focused investors rather than speculative appreciation-only strategies.
buyer_guidance: Use all-in monthly payment as the main affordability screen.
Compare Plumas Lake, Wheatland, Marysville, and Yuba City by commute, school zones, safety, and property age.
Verify insurance, utility, and wildfire-adjacent cost assumptions before committing.
Do not choose strictly by proximity; choose by total fit.
Use PCSUnited calculators to compare rent, buy, residual income, and assignment-length risk.
seller_guidance: Price against current buyer payment sensitivity, not just California home-price expectations.
Highlight commute logic, school-zone clarity, condition, and low-maintenance features.
Homes with newer systems, clean inspections, and practical military-family appeal should be positioned clearly.
Military buyers need practical monthly value, not just emotional listing copy.
landlord_notes: Military renter demand can support stable occupancy near Beale.
Single-family rentals in good commute corridors may appeal to families avoiding purchase risk.
Investors should model vacancy, maintenance, insurance, and California ownership costs conservatively.
Clean, practical homes in Plumas Lake or Wheatland may outperform generic low-cost inventory.

base_profile.installation_type: High-altitude ISR / reconnaissance host-wing Air Force base
base_profile.host_or_major_command: Air Combat Command / Sixteenth Air Force / 9th Reconnaissance Wing (host wing)
base_profile.primary_mission_summary: Beale Air Force Base is hosted by the 9th Reconnaissance Wing under Sixteenth Air Force and Air Combat Command. Current official MilitaryINSTALLATIONS and 9th Reconnaissance Wing language describes the host wing as equipped with the nation's only fleet of U-2 Dragon Lady high-altitude reconnaissance aircraft, supported by T-38 companion trainers, and tasked to provide high-altitude reconnaissance, mission-ready Airmen, and combat-ammunition expertise while delivering resilient installation services. An official Air Combat Command article dated July 2022 states the RQ-4 Global Hawk Block 30 flying mission at Beale ended when the final aircraft assigned to the 12th Reconnaissance Squadron departed. A September 2025 ACC leadership visit described ongoing preparations for mission transitions, including possible Collaborative Combat Aircraft integration; treat that as a sourced potential transition, not a completed aircraft change.
mission_partners: Sixteenth Air Force / Air Combat Command
Air Force Combat Ammunition Center / 9th Munitions Squadron
940th Air Refueling Wing (Air Force Reserve Command / KC-135)

12th Reconnaissance Squadron (MilitaryINSTALLATIONS still lists this 319th Reconnaissance Wing unit as physically remaining at Beale after the 2019 realignment; RQ-4 Block 30 flying at Beale ended in 2022 per ACC)
base_profile.pcs_personality: Rural-suburban Northern California PCS decision: California payment pressure without coastal pricing, Wheatland and Plumas Lake family corridors, Marysville/Yuba City screening, fog and rural-road commute risk, and strong dependence on which of five gates is actually open.
base_profile.base_bluf: Beale is not a generic California housing market. Families should compare Wheatland, Plumas Lake, Marysville, Yuba City, and longer Lincoln-edge options against BAH, insurance, wildfire-adjacent risk, school assignment by exact address, and a realistic gate/report-time commute. On-base housing can reduce commute uncertainty on a geographically large installation.

installation_population.scope: MilitaryINSTALLATIONS published active-duty figure only. Not a combined total-force census and not Marysville, Yuba City, Yuba County, or Sacramento metro population.
installation_population.note: MilitaryINSTALLATIONS publishes Active duty 4,587; Family members 4,284; Civilian employees 772; Contractors 507; Reservists/Guard 1,071; and Retirees 25,000. The same page's narrative lists 611 reservists and 239 guardsmen (850), which conflicts with the 1,071 Reservists/Guard line. Those unlike categories are not added into a fabricated grand total. The 25,000 retirees/widows/retiree family members are a surrounding-area support statement, not on-installation population. The same page's Yuba-Sutter civilian figure and five-county civilian population are not installation population. Cows listed on the same page are not people and are not used here. Treat as a published profile, not a live 2026 headcount.
installation_population.source_freshness: MilitaryINSTALLATIONS Beale overview reviewed 2026-09-16; underlying headcount year is not stated. Treat as a published profile, not a live headcount.

access_guidance.bluf: Beale currently operates five named gates. Visitors without an accepted DoD ID must be sponsored. Official homepage and REAL ID article state REAL ID-compliant identification or another accepted credential is required. Visitor passes are processed by 9th SFS at the Visitors Center adjacent to Wheatland Gate and by Pass and Registration. Gate hours are time-sensitive; call 530-634-2131 immediately before travel.
current_posture: Official homepage: all visitors accessing the base must be REAL ID compliant; if the visitor does not yet have a REAL ID driver's license, a second form of government-issued identification such as a valid U.S. passport is needed.
Official 7 May 2025 REAL ID article: possession of a REAL ID alone does not grant access; visitors must still be sponsored and accompanied by a DoD ID cardholder at all times while on base.

Official 9th SFS visitor-pass guidance: sponsors may email 9SFS.VCC.RegistrationRequest@us.af.mil; Pass and Registration 530-634-3128; DBIDS pre-enrollment is available; visitors can also obtain a pass at the gate on initial arrival. Wheatland Gate is listed for duty-hour pass printing Monday-Friday 0730-1600 in that guidance.
Sponsors and visitors may meet at the Visitors Center adjacent to Wheatland Gate for vetting and 1-30 day passes.

Gold Country Inn is the published 24-hour arrival point for newcomers, not a substitute for 9th SFS visitor-pass processing. The official Directory lists Welcome/Visitors Center at the lodging number 530-634-2953, which is a naming conflict with the Wheatland-adjacent SFS Visitors Center.
DeCA Beale store page published gate hours effective 14 April 2026. Older official PDFs and some newcomer pages disagree. Verify with 9th SFS 530-634-2131 before travel.
access_guidance.access_questions_contact: 9th SFS / Law Enforcement Desk 530-634-2131; Pass and Registration 530-634-3128 / 9SFS.VCC.RegistrationRequest@us.af.mil; Base Operator 530-634-3000

user_positioning.military_family_bluf: Prioritize school-zone verification by exact address, Wheatland versus Plumas Lake versus Marysville tradeoffs, insurance and wildfire-adjacent cost, and a commute tested to the gate that will actually be open at report time.
user_positioning.single_airman_bluf: Confirm unaccompanied-housing eligibility first. If living off base, prioritize West Gate/Schneider or other 24/7 access, rental flexibility, and not overpaying for newer family housing that does not fit the tour length.
user_positioning.realtor_bluf: The strongest Beale conversations are about California all-in payment, which gate the client can actually use, Wheatland versus Plumas Lake versus Marysville screening, and whether assignment length supports buying.
user_positioning.investor_bluf: Rental demand is influenced by military turnover, limited nearby inventory, and the need for clean single-family homes in practical commute corridors — not by Sacramento-metro appreciation assumptions.

best_for: Investors comfortable with property-level due diligence
recommended_neighborhoods.commute_band: Approx. 15-30 minutes depending on exact address, gate, traffic, weather, and report time
likely_gate_logic: Schneider Gate via North Beale Road
Doolittle Gate during published weekday hours depending on route
Other gates depending on current access rules
watchouts: Crime and property condition vary by area
Older housing stock can increase maintenance exposure
School assignment must be verified
Resale appeal can be neighborhood-sensitive
recommended_neighborhoods.pcsu_recommendation: Use Marysville selectively. It can work financially, but the best choices require address-level due diligence.

recommended_neighborhoods.name: Yuba City
recommended_neighborhoods.fit_summary: Broader services, shopping, and housing options across Sutter County, with a longer commute tradeoff for many addresses.
recommended_neighborhoods.commute_band: Approx. 25-45 minutes depending on exact address, gate, traffic, weather, and report time
likely_gate_logic: Wheatland Gate during published weekday hours depending on route
Other gates depending on duty location
watchouts: Commute can become a daily quality-of-life factor
Exact route reliability should be tested, including CA-99/CA-70 connections
Prices and school quality vary by pocket
recommended_neighborhoods.pcsu_recommendation: Good for users who want more services and broader inventory, as long as commute and payment stay controlled.

recommended_neighborhoods.name: Lincoln Edge / Southern Commute Corridors
recommended_neighborhoods.fit_summary: Higher-cost southern option with stronger regional amenities and potential resale appeal, but commute and affordability must be stress-tested.
best_for: Families willing to accept a longer commute
recommended_neighborhoods.commute_band: Approx. 35-60+ minutes depending on exact address, gate, traffic, weather, and report time
likely_gate_logic: Wheatland Gate during published weekday hours via CA-65
Schneider Gate as a 24/7 backup depending on route
Other gates depending on duty location
watchouts: Higher prices may stretch BAH profiles

recommended_neighborhoods.pcsu_recommendation: Only makes sense when the user has stronger income, a longer timeline, and a clear reason to accept the commute and higher price.

commute_intelligence.commute_bluf: Beale commute pressure is usually lighter than major California metros, but the installation is geographically large and rural. Gate choice, CA-70 / CA-65 / North Beale Road, tule fog, and the exact duty location can matter more than mileage. Times below are approximate and depend on exact address, gate, traffic, weather, and report time.
commute_intelligence.overall_commute_posture: Generally manageable compared with major California metros if the household plans around published gate hours, keeps a 24/7 Schneider or Vassar Lake backup, and tests the route during expected report time.
primary_commute_factors: Five-gate network with only Schneider and Vassar Lake listed 24/7 on the 14 April 2026 dated public schedule
CA-70, CA-65, North Beale Road, Camp Beale Highway, and Hammonton-Smartsville Road
Tule fog and wet-season rural-road conditions
School drop-off timing in Wheatland, Marysville, and Yuba City
On-base distance between housing areas and the actual duty location
No military airport shuttle from Sacramento International Airport
primary_commute_risks: Choosing by mileage instead of actual gate commute
Assuming Wheatland or Doolittle will be open on weekends, holidays, or after hours
Longer daily drives from Yuba City, Lincoln-edge areas, or Sacramento-region corridors
Fog and wet-weather delays on rural approaches
On-base housing that still requires a long internal drive to the work location

commute_bands.label: Close-in
commute_bands.range: Approx. 0-20 minutes depending on gate, traffic, weather, and exact address
commute_bands.fit: Best for users prioritizing proximity: on-base housing, Wheatland, and selected closer Marysville pockets
commute_bands.watchout: Close-in still needs school, safety, and property screening. On-base distance can surprise first-time arrivals.

commute_bands.label: Balanced
commute_bands.range: Approx. 20-35 minutes depending on gate, traffic, weather, and exact address
commute_bands.fit: Often the best balance between newer housing and commute, especially Plumas Lake and selected Yuba-Sutter pockets
commute_bands.watchout: Gate choice and fog can still change the real commute.

commute_bands.label: Lifestyle tradeoff
commute_bands.range: Approx. 35-60+ minutes depending on gate, traffic, weather, and exact address
commute_bands.fit: May work for families wanting Lincoln-edge amenities, broader Sacramento-region services, or specific schools
commute_bands.watchout: Can become painful for early reporting, weekend duty, or frequent base errands.

gate_selection_logic: Start with the user's likely duty location and whether they will live on base or off base.
Identify the realistic 24/7 gates under the current dated listing (Schneider and Vassar Lake).
Use Wheatland Gate only during published weekday hours, especially from Wheatland / CA-65.
Use Doolittle Gate only during published weekday hours.
Treat Grass Valley Gate as a limited peak-window option, not a default.
Keep a Schneider or Vassar Lake backup for nights, weekends, holidays, and fog delays.
Do not choose a neighborhood based only on mileage.
planning_guidance: Test the commute during the user's expected report-time window, including at least one low-visibility morning if arriving in winter.
Confirm which gate best supports the user's duty location and day of week.
Compare Wheatland, Plumas Lake, Marysville, and Yuba City by route reliability, not just price.
If flying into Sacramento International Airport, plan sponsor pickup or a rental car; official MilitaryINSTALLATIONS notes there is no military shuttle.
Use commute plus all-in housing cost, including insurance, as the core PCSUnited decision screen.
commute_intelligence.user_instruction: Before signing a lease or contract, users should test the commute from the exact property address to the expected gate during the same time window they would normally report to work. Times are approximate and depend on gate, traffic, weather, and exact address.
commute_intelligence.pcsu_bluf: Beale commute pressure is manageable when the home is chosen against the actual open gate and report time. Distance is not the same as commute.

bah_market_reality.bah_bluf: Beale should be modeled as a more approachable California market than coastal or major-metro installations, not as a cheap market. BAH is a decision filter, not a promise of affordability. Compare BAH against rent or mortgage, California purchase prices, insurance, utilities, commute cost, debt, residual income, and assignment length.
bah_market_reality.overall_position: Favorable for disciplined buyers, but California pricing still requires payment discipline.
bah_market_reality.buying_power_summary: Beale offers more attainable California buying power than many other California bases, especially in Wheatland, Plumas Lake, and select Yuba-Sutter corridors. Headline prices can still create high monthly payments once insurance, utilities, and commute cost are included.
bah_market_reality.renting_summary: Renting remains practical for shorter assignments, unaccompanied personnel, or households not ready to absorb California ownership costs and transaction risk.
recommended_calculations: BAH with dependents vs estimated rent
BAH without dependents vs estimated rent
Total housing cost including insurance and utilities vs 30% income lane
Residual monthly income after expenses and housing
Rent vs buy break-even horizon / assignment-length exit strategy
watch_items: Older-home maintenance exposure in Marysville and select areas
Exit strategy if the tour is short
bah_market_reality.base_tab_message: Show BAH as a decision filter, not a promise of affordability. Push users into the PCSUnited financial calculator when insurance, commute cost, or residual income looks tight even if the purchase price looks lower than other California bases.
bah_market_reality.pcsu_strategy_note: Beale should be modeled as a favorable California affordability market relative to coastal installations, but PCSUnited should still test each user's rank, BAH, debt, savings, credit score, insurance quotes, timeline, and location preference before recommending buy versus rent.

family_readiness.family_bluf: Beale can be a strong family PCS location when the household chooses the right corridor, verifies school assignment by exact address, plans childcare early, and protects against California payment pressure, insurance, and rural commute risk. It is more geographically spread out than urban installations, but it is not isolated from Yuba-Sutter services.

school_guidance.on_base_option: Lone Tree Elementary is a documented on-base/Wheatland-area school associated with Beale-connected families in official photos and local coverage. Treat it as a research starting point only. Exact attendance boundaries must be verified by housing address.
school_guidance.school_liaison_address: Building 3308, Child and Youth Resource Center, Beale AFB, CA 95903
school_guidance.school_zone_warning: Always verify school assignment by exact residence before signing a lease or purchase contract. Official newcomer pages list Wheatland, Yuba City, Marysville, Grass Valley, Roseville, Rocklin, and related systems as local options; none of those is a guaranteed assignment.
school_guidance.nearby_school_district_note: Common off-base research includes Wheatland schools, Marysville schools, and Yuba City schools. Wheatland Union High School received a 2025 Purple Star honor in official Beale news coverage; that is a support designation, not a promise of assignment or quality for every address.

childcare_guidance.cdc_note: Official Directory lists Child Development Center 530-634-4717 and Child and Youth Resource Center 530-634-4418. Availability, waitlists, and eligibility should be verified through MilitaryChildCare.com or current 9th FSS Child and Youth Services resources.
childcare_guidance.youth_program_note: Official Directory lists Youth Center 530-634-4953 and Family Child Care 530-812-3117. Confirm current waitlists and hours before making a housing decision around childcare.

medical_guidance.urgent_care: Official Urgent & Emergency Care page: Beale does not offer urgent or emergency care services. Call 911 for emergencies. Nurse Advice Line 1-800-TRICARE (874-2273). The same official page lists nearby civilian urgent-care options in Yuba City, Auburn, Grass Valley, and Lincoln as community references, not on-base capability.
medical_guidance.medical_warning: Do not assume on-base emergency capability. Plan a civilian emergency-department backup. Verify clinic availability, referrals, pharmacy procedures, and the Wednesday 9:30 a.m. training opening directly with official medical sources.
medical_guidance.general_hours_note: Appointment line Monday-Friday 7:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; clinic opens 9:30 a.m. Wednesdays for readiness training. Family Health 7:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Pharmacy Monday-Friday 7:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m., closed Wednesday training mornings 7:30-9:15 a.m.

military_family_readiness_center.name: Beale Military & Family Readiness Center
military_family_readiness_center.hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 7:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Wednesday 7:30 a.m.-1:30 p.m. per official Beale Information Central

family_readiness.spouse_employment_note: Official A&FRC/Career Focus listing is 530-634-2863. Yuba-Sutter employment is smaller than Sacramento-metro options. Dual-commute households considering Lincoln, Rocklin, Roseville, or Sacramento should test both work locations against Beale report time rather than assuming a Sacramento job automatically fits a Beale housing choice.

Wheatland and Plumas Lake family corridors
More approachable California pricing than many coastal installations
On-base housing, CDCs, School Liaison, and A&FRC available as planning anchors
Manageable commute options when housing and gate choice are aligned
watchouts: School assignments must be verified by exact address
Marysville and older districts vary materially
California payment pressure can still tighten budgets
Insurance, utilities, heat, and wildfire-adjacent risk should be considered
No on-base urgent or emergency care
Some preferred amenity areas require a long CA-65 commute
family_readiness.pcsu_family_bluf: Beale can work well for families who want Northern California access without coastal pricing, but it requires disciplined screening for schools, commute, insurance, and all-in payment.

before_arrival: Verify current gate status with 9th SFS at 530-634-2131 and review the latest public gate listing. Do not rely on an old PDF.
If visitor access is needed, start 9th SFS pass procedures early: 9SFS.VCC.RegistrationRequest@us.af.mil or 530-634-3128. REAL ID and sponsorship rules apply.
Confirm sponsor contact and unit CSS reporting instructions.
Call Gold Country Inn at 530-634-2953. It is the published 24-hour arrival point. Ask about TLF and the two pet-friendly TLF spaces; pet-friendly VAQ/VOQ units are not currently offered.
Review Military Housing Office guidance at 530-634-2731 before signing a lease or purchase contract.
Compare BAH against rent or mortgage, California insurance, utilities, commute cost, debt, and assignment length.
Shortlist Wheatland, Plumas Lake, Marysville, Yuba City, and on-base housing by realistic 24/7 Schneider or Vassar Lake access.
Verify school assignment by exact residence with the School Liaison at 530-634-3539.
Plan Sacramento International Airport pickup. Official MilitaryINSTALLATIONS notes there is no military shuttle and airport cabs/rentals are not reimbursable.
arrival_and_inprocessing: If arriving after hours, report to Gold Country Inn at 24112 A Street and contact the sponsor.
If arriving during duty hours, official arriving guidance says report first to the squadron Commander Support Staff.
MPF Customer Support in-processing is listed Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at 0900 at 17855 Warren Shingle Rd after unit CSS check-in.
Use A&FRC at 17800 13th Street, 530-634-2863, for relocation information and referrals.
Contact TMO Personal Property at 530-634-2936 / 530-634-8421 for household-goods issues.
first_week: Complete unit check-in, MPF, medical, and required Right Start appointments as scheduled by the unit/CSS.
Visit or contact the housing office if still deciding between on-base and off-base options.
Confirm medical, pharmacy, and emergency-care procedures. There is no on-base urgent or emergency care; call 911 for emergencies.
Drive the commute from target neighborhoods during the actual expected report window, including a 24/7 gate backup.
Tour properties before committing when possible.
Avoid choosing housing solely by distance, rent, or list price.
first_30_days: Finalize housing only after comparing commute, BAH fit, insurance, school needs, and total monthly cost.
Save operator, 9th SFS, Pass and Registration, medical, housing, TMO, and family-readiness contacts.
Update PCSUnited financial inputs with final housing numbers.
Review whether the selected area supports assignment length, family needs, resale/rental exit risk, and daily quality of life.
legacy_flat_checklist: Verify current gate hours and visitor access procedures through official Beale AFB sources.
Confirm whether on-base housing or off-base housing better fits rank, dependents, BAH, pets, school needs, and expected assignment length.
Compare Plumas Lake, Wheatland, Marysville, and Yuba City using commute, schools, safety, and all-in monthly cost.
Check insurance and utility estimates before finalizing a purchase budget.
Verify school zones by exact property address.
Review roof, HVAC, insulation, drainage, wildfire-adjacent considerations, and heat-related utility exposure before buying.
Use PCSUnited calculators to compare rent, buy, residual income, and risk level before committing.

pcs_watchouts.title: Gate hours conflict across official pages
pcs_watchouts.message: Use 9th SFS 530-634-2131 immediately before travel. The most recently dated public listing on the DeCA Beale store page (effective 14 April 2026) is Schneider 24/7, Vassar Lake 24/7, Wheatland 0500-1800 Monday-Friday, Doolittle 0600-1800 Monday-Friday, and Grass Valley peak windows. Older official PDFs and some newcomer pages disagree.

pcs_watchouts.title: Visitor access is not the same as lodging check-in
pcs_watchouts.message: Visitor passes are a 9th SFS process (Wheatland-adjacent Visitors Center / Pass and Registration 530-634-3128). Gold Country Inn is the 24-hour arrival point at 530-634-2953. REAL ID and sponsorship rules apply. A public BDOC number was not published.

pcs_watchouts.title: RQ-4 flying at Beale ended; do not use old ISR language as current
pcs_watchouts.message: Official ACC reporting: the RQ-4 Global Hawk Block 30 flying mission at Beale ended in July 2022. Current official MilitaryINSTALLATIONS language centers the host wing on the U-2 fleet, with T-38 and KC-135 also listed among today's aircraft. A September 2025 ACC visit described possible future mission transitions, including Collaborative Combat Aircraft integration — sourced as potential, not completed.

pcs_watchouts.title: Distance is not the same as commute
pcs_watchouts.message: The installation is geographically large. Neighborhoods should be compared by realistic 24/7 gate access, duty location, CA-70/CA-65 routing, and fog/report-time windows. Times are approximate and depend on gate, traffic, weather, and exact address.

pcs_watchouts.title: School assignments are residence-specific
pcs_watchouts.message: Verify school assignment by exact property address with the School Liaison at 530-634-3539. Do not assume Lone Tree Elementary or any Wheatland/Marysville/Yuba City school is automatically assigned.

pcs_watchouts.title: BAH is not the full affordability picture
pcs_watchouts.message: Beale is more approachable than many California bases, not cheap. Compare rent or mortgage against income, debt, utilities, insurance, commute cost, savings goals, and assignment length.

pcs_watchouts.title: Published population is an MOS profile, not a live census
pcs_watchouts.message: MilitaryINSTALLATIONS publishes 4,587 active duty and other categories separately. Reservists/Guard 1,071 conflicts with the narrative 611 reservists plus 239 guardsmen. Do not use Marysville, Yuba-Sutter, or five-county civilian population as installation population. The 25,000 retiree figure is not on-installation population.

pcs_watchouts.title: No on-base urgent or emergency care
pcs_watchouts.message: Official 9th Medical Group guidance: Beale does not offer urgent or emergency care. Call 911 for emergencies and use the Nurse Advice Line 1-800-TRICARE (874-2273).

pcs_watchouts.title: On-base housing is not automatically the best financial answer
pcs_watchouts.message: On-base Balfour Beatty housing can reduce rural commute uncertainty, but waitlists, BAH treatment, school assignment, and off-base Wheatland/Plumas Lake options still need a side-by-side comparison.

realtor_intelligence.best_client_positioning: Lead with California affordability strategy, BAH discipline, commute realism against the actual open gate, and Wheatland versus Plumas Lake versus Marysville screening. Beale clients need a guide who can separate good value from cheap risk.

buyer_personas.agent_strategy: Lead with all-in payment clarity, insurance quotes, commute testing, and VA loan education. Do not sell on headline price alone.

buyer_personas.agent_strategy: Compare Wheatland, Plumas Lake, selected Marysville, Yuba City, and on-base Balfour Beatty housing against commute, parish/district school assignment, and monthly cost.

likely_questions: Do I have to live in the dorms?
Where should I avoid signing too fast?
buyer_personas.agent_strategy: Confirm UH eligibility first. Keep off-base recommendations practical: 24/7 gate access, rent, safety, property condition, and lease flexibility.

likely_questions: Should I buy if I may be here longer?
Can a Sacramento or Lincoln job work with a Beale commute?
What areas have resale strength with military buyers?
buyer_personas.agent_strategy: Use assignment length, dual-commute geography, family needs, insurance, and rent-versus-buy math. Do not assume a Lincoln/Roseville home automatically fits a Beale report time.
